title: Binary File Writer
text: Write data to binary files, 1 input, no direct feedthrough; {File name} sets the name of the file, {File header} sets the size of the header struct and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Data to write column vector | row vector | matrix

params.name: File name
params.values: Name of the file ’Untitled.bin’ (default) | character vector

params.name: File header
params.values: Size of the header struct([]) (default) | structure

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation
